title: It broke after a year
text: It broke after a year. I got this in July of 2012. It's August of 2013. We did not use it every day. Problem was my roomie was mashing too much in too hard, wearing headphones with loud music so he could not hear the change in the sound of the motor, and the plastic part of the "grindie thing" as he put it, melted. We did split the cost of the juicer and it looks like we'll have to do that again. I'm thinking it was "User Error" that caused the break. He agrees with my assessment.
